svg.title: F / PA-backed PSC publication with destination NAT
svg.desc: Candidate: replace RP backends with regional Palo appliances and map the service VIP to the workload.. Blue lines show application traffic; green dashed lines show return traffic; amber dotted lines show native health checks; gray dotted lines show resource or policy references. Purple lines show policy-directed inspection. Red lines show rejected or bypass paths. See adjacent ADR option for requirements.
